title: ScalarTensorGlobalSectionsMorphism
statement: For a field k, a scheme X over Spec k, module sheaves F and G, and global sections s and t, the composite of the inverse left unitor, the tensor of the scalar section morphisms for s and t, and the scalar tensor coefficient equals the scalar section morphism for the tensor section tmulSection s t.

proof.text: Use the sheafification adjunction and its monoidal unit law to reduce equality of morphisms out of the scalar unit to equality after evaluation on one. The tensorator sends the pure tensor of the two section values to tmulSection, by exists_scalarTensorCoefficient. The two morphisms therefore agree on one and hence agree.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTensorCoefficient_globalSections_morphism
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules)
    (s : scalarObj f F (op ⊤)) (t : scalarObj f G (op ⊤)) :
    (λ_ (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k))).inv ≫
        ((scalarUnitMorphism f ≫ scalarHom f (homOfGlobalSection F s)) ⊗ₘ
          (scalarUnitMorphism f ≫ scalarHom f (homOfGlobalSection G t))) ≫
        scalarTensorCoefficient f F G =
      scalarUnitMorphism f ≫ scalarHom f (homOfGlobalSection (F ⊗ G) (tmulSection s t))
